# §0/1 · #3 — The Formal-Limit Genealogy

<!-- reader-navigation -->
Movement 04 of 48 · [This room](../ROOM.md) · [← Previous](03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger.md) · [Next →](05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md)
<!-- /reader-navigation -->

## Claim
A sufficiently articulate system cannot convert every condition of its articulation into an ordinary internal term without remainder.

## Warrant
[[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/russell/russell-1908-theory-types/russell-1908-theory-types.md|Russell]] restrict paradoxical re-entry; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/godel/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions.md|Gödel]] proves scoped internal limits; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/wittgenstein/wittgenstein-1922-tractatus/wittgenstein-1922-tractatus.md|Wittgenstein]] reaches silence and practice; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md|Whitehead]] makes non-closure creative; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form.md|Spencer-Brown]] and [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference.md|Varela]] admit re-entry; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/history-philosophy-of-science/frank/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot.md|The Blind Spot — Frank, Gleiser, Thompson]] restores the experiencer.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field|Paradox]] shows how this limit moves across registers without becoming one homogenised theorem. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field|Cusa's]] polygon approaches the circle while retaining the difference between finite measure and infinite form; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/flasch/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart.md|Flasch's account of Eckhart]] follows a language that affirms, qualifies, and returns each predicate to what exceeds it; poetry keeps the opening alive where a terminating definition would close. The anonymous medieval infinite-sphere image is used with its attribution intact: Cusa receives and transforms it rather than originating it.

## Tension / limit
Gödel performs a formal proof; Cusa and Eckhart perform mathematical-apophatic and linguistic disciplines; Whitehead supplies process metaphysics, and Bohm's process bridge enters only at #5→0. Their distinct objects and methods prevent their convergence from being mistaken for one theorem and give the wider architecture its strength.

## Anchor and transition

[E3’s fides before arbitration](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#fides-before-arbitration) gives the enquiry its prior reliance and its subsequent renewed entrustment: formal investigation already undertakes a practice before it can arbitrate its results. Russell’s, Gödel’s and Wittgenstein’s distinct limits retain their own scopes. Fides and Credere articulate the project’s relational passage through those limits; Latin lexical history neither derives nor proves the formal results.

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../../../symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **returns-to** the authorial relation carried through A03 and A23: investigation makes determinations; [faith consciously continues through their non-exhaustion of ground](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#trust-keeps-the-return-route-active). Its whole four-line movement remains available as a contemplation object. Each historical response in this Movement retains its own method and warrant.
**Mathematical anchor:** undecidability under stated formal conditions. **Images:** the ladder, the re-entering mark, the polygon approaching the circle, the sphere with centre everywhere and circumference nowhere. The positive response is [[05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity|§0/1 · #4 — Gebserian Diaphaneity]].

The [Formal Limit dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md) **historicises** the genealogy through distinct consequences: Russell restricts formation, Gödel bounds derivability within a stated theory, and the early Wittgenstein distinguishes saying and showing. The later practice inquiry keeps its separate work identity. Cusa’s theological precision and Eckhart’s qualified predication retain their own objects; their conjunction gives the next inquiry more exact permissions and responsibilities without making the histories one theorem.

Tractatus4.1212 and7 bear a source-specific limit; later practice requires its separate work and edition; the [language history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-practice) **qualifies** this historical attribution.

The [authored P1 route for M04](../P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT.md#p1-m04) **grounds** this movement’s canonical A/C alignment within the phase bounds and dispositions stated there.
